title: Tekken 3
description: The King of Iron Fist returns. Master a new generation of fighters, take on the arcade ladder, or challenge a friend.

title: Metal Gear Solid

title: Silent Hill

description: Take your national team to the world stage and chase the trophy in the official 2002 tournament game.
